samples.title: REAL: Spark text -> Muse Image -> SAM 3.1 -> Spark vision (recorded 2026-11-02)
samples.description: Real four-tool Meta chain recorded 2026-11-02, subject 1 of 3 (notification preferences with toggle switches and top tabs): Muse Spark text wrote the image prompt, Muse Image generated the UI screenshot, SAM 3.1 proposed 12 boxes over 4 phrases (HTTP 200 each), Muse Spark pure vision named all 12 numbered marks. Replay only: steps replay the recorded calls with their recorded durations and make no live model calls. Run footer gives the 3-run totals as counts only (generated images have no ground truth).
chain: Muse Spark text writes the image prompt
Muse Image generates the UI screenshot
Muse Spark vision names each numbered mark

samples.title: REAL: voice -> Muse Spark vision -> verify (recorded calls)
samples.description: Real Meta tool calls recorded on 2026-11-02 (pure vision, agent tools off): speech transcription, then Muse Spark finds the named element on a synthetic GUI screenshot, then a deterministic check against the generator's ground truth. Synthetic screenshots, TTS speech, small n; replay shows the recorded timings, not a live run.
chain: Aggregate over every task in the run
